newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Minproc Chile unit has administrator.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Minproc Chile unit has administrator.

text.p: Mining engineer Minproc Engineers Ltd said on Wednesday that voluntary administrators had been appointed to its Chilean subsidiary Minproc Overseas Projects Pty Ltd which is building the Yolanda Nitrates project.

The company said the appointment of accountancy firm Taylor Woodings would substantially quarantine the impact of the fixed-price contruction dispute. "It also limits the flow-on effect to Minproc Engineers Ltd," the company said, adding that the appointment followed failed talks with its client Minera Yolanda, a unit of Canada's Kap Resources Ltd.
Minproc said it has begun legal action to recover more than US$9.5 million from the Kap unit and which compared with the US$4.625 million limit of liability stated in the project contracts.
It said an initial arbitration hearing had ruled that Minera Yolanda set aside US$7.2 million in cash pending resolution of the dispute.
"This action does not inhibit Minproc Engineers' ability to continue to operate on a worldwide basis, including Chile," Minproc chairman Brett Fogarty said.
"A successful outcome of the arbitration process could see the subsidiary, Minproc Overseas Projects Pty Ltd, come out of administration and return to trading," Fogarty said.
Minproc shares were steady at 46 cents on Wednesday, two cents above its 12 month low.
The company has a market capitalisation of A$25.53 million.
